changelog: 🧠 A Models screen — ThorAI Settings › Choose models… — pick which model does each job: routing, reasoning, coding, writing, seeing. Any model you've installed can fill any role, and it takes effect on your next request.

⬇️ Install a model by voice from HuggingFace — say "download the Dolphin Cyber model from HuggingFace" and ThorOS finds the real model, picks a version, and offers to download it. No typing long addresses.

🛡️ It can learn what's normal (optional, off by default) — quietly notes which programs run and what your machine connects to, so it can one day flag something genuinely new like an unknown program opening a port. Watches for weeks first; nothing leaves your machine.
🗣️ It answers instead of gesturing — "which models do I have?" now names them out loud, same for voices and role assignments.
✅ Downloads are honest — a model download shows up when you ask "how's it going", and it says out loud when it's done or if it failed, instead of silence.
🎯 It won't invent an answer — an unrecognised question no longer comes back as a random report on your memory and load; it says it isn't sure and helps instead.
ℹ️ After updating, log out and back in to finish loading the new version.
